{{small|(8 November 2017)}} | attendance = 2,662,998 | average attendance = 8,703 | prevseason = [[2016 Indonesia Soccer Championship A|2016 ISC A]] | nextseason = [[2018 Liga 1 (Indonesia)|2018]] }} The '''2017 Liga 1''', also known as '''Go-Jek Traveloka Liga 1''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web|title=Jadi Sponsor Liga 1, Gojek-Traveloka Sumbang Rp 180 Miliar|url=http://bola.liputan6.com/read/2916118/jadi-sponsor-liga-1-gojek-traveloka-sumbang-rp-180-miliar|website=liputan6.com|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170413012508/http://bola.liputan6.com/read/2916118/jadi-sponsor-liga-1-gojek-traveloka-sumbang-rp-180-miliar|archive-date=13 April 2017|url-status=live}} was the inaugural season of [[Liga 1 (Indonesia)|Liga 1]] under its current name and the 8th season of the top-flight Indonesian professional league for [[association football]] clubs since its establishment in 2008.{{cite web|url=http://www.bola.net/indonesia/pssi-ubah-isl-jadi-liga-1-6a5497.html|title=PSSI Ubah ISL Jadi Liga 1|publisher=Bola.net |date=20 January 2017 |access-date=20 January 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170122145149/http://www.bola.net/indonesia/pssi-ubah-isl-jadi-liga-1-6a5497.html|archive-date=22 January 2017|url-status=live}} It was the first official professional league season held post-[[FIFA]] sanction. The season started on 15 April 2017 and ended on 12 November 2017. Fixtures for the 2017 season were announced on 11 April 2017.{{Cite web|url=http://www.topskor.id/detail/49626/login.html|title=Jadwal Resmi Liga 1 Diumumkan, Barito Putera vs Mitra Kukar Jadi Laga Pertama {{!}} TOPSKOR|last=topskor.id|website=TOPSKOR|language=en-US|access-date=2017-05-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170416042648/http://www.topskor.id/detail/49626/login.html|archive-date=2017-04-16|url-status=dead}} [[2014 Indonesia Super League]] winners [[Persib Bandung|Persib]] were the defending champions, as the [[2015 Indonesia Super League]] was abandoned midway due to [[FIFA]] suspension while the [[2016 Indonesia Soccer Championship A]] was not counted as an official league. [[Bhayangkara F.C.|Bhayangkara]] won their first Liga 1 title with one match to spare.{{cite web|title=Hattrick Spaso Antar Bhayangkara FC Juara Liga 1|url=http://bola.liputan6.com/read/3156236/hattrick-spaso-antar-bhayangkara-fc-juara-liga-1|website=liputan6.com|access-date=8 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171109022700/http://bola.liputan6.com/read/3156236/hattrick-spaso-antar-bhayangkara-fc-juara-liga-1|archive-date=9 November 2017|url-status=live}} The season was marred by the death of [[Persela Lamongan|Persela]]'s longtime goalkeeper, [[Choirul Huda]].{{cite news|url=https://bola.kompas.com/read/2017/10/16/06060068/kronologi-meninggalnya-kiper-persela-choirul-huda|title=Kronologi Meninggalnya Kiper Persela Choirul Huda|last=Christian|first=Anju|editor-last=Wirajati|editor-first=Jalu Wisnu|date=16 October 2017|work=Kompas.com|language=id}} ==Overview== ===Referees=== In December 2016, [[PSSI]] and the league operator planned to use foreign referees for the 2017 competition. The use of foreign referee was intended to improve the quality of the competition.{{cite web|url=http://www.bola.net/indonesia/pssi-pakai-wasit-asing-di-kompetisi-2017-fc31e6.html|title=PSSI Pakai Wasit Asing di Kompetisi 2017|publisher=Bola.net|date=22 December 2016|access-date=24 December 2016|language=id}} However, two weeks before the league starts, this plan was cancelled.{{cite web|url=http://www.goal.com/id-ID/news/1391/liga-1-indonesia/2017/03/30/34149282/liga-1-dipastikan-tidak-pakai-wasit-asing|title=Liga 1 Dipastikan Tidak Pakai Wasit Asing|publisher=goal.com|date=30 March 2017|access-date=31 March 2017|language=id}} After a wide criticism, protest and dissatisfaction towards the local referees during the first round of the season,{{Cite web|url=https://kumparan.com/haikal-pasya/wasit-dihukum-lagi|title=Wasit Dihukum (Lagi)|website=kumparan|language=id-ID|access-date=2017-08-11}}{{Cite news|url=http://www.viva.co.id/bola/liga-indonesia/933802-wasit-masih-jadi-masalah-serius-pt-lib|title=Wasit Masih Jadi Masalah Serius PT LIB - VIVA.co.id|last=VIVA.co.id|first=PT. VIVA MEDIA BARU -|date=2017-07-11|access-date=2017-08-11|language=id}} PSSI revisited the idea. On 18 July 2017, PSSI and the league operator officially announced the use of foreign referees and assistant referees in select matches for the second round.{{cite web|url=http://bola.republika.co.id/berita/sepakbola/liga-indonesia/17/07/18/otaco0-liga-1-2017-resmi-gunakan-wasit-asing|title=Liga 1 2017 Resmi Gunakan Wasit Asing|publisher=republika.co.id|date=18 news|url=http://www.pikiran-rakyat.com/olah-raga/2017/07/27/enam-wasit-asing-siap-diturunkan-di-putaran-kedua-liga-1-406198|title=Enam Wasit Asing Siap Diturunkan di Putaran Kedua Liga 1|date=2017-07-27|work=Pikiran Rakyat|access-date=2017-08-11|language=id}} ===Player regulation=== League operator also introduced several new regulations, such as requiring clubs to contract a minimum of five U-23 local players with three of them having to play as starting lineup minimum of 45 minutes in a match, restricting clubs to have more than two players older than 35 years old, and increasing the maximum number of substitutions to five for each team in a match.{{cite web|url=http://bola.kompas.com/read/2017/03/30/10150048/aturan.liga.1.setiap.tim.bisa.lima.kali.ganti.pemain|title=Aturan Liga 1, Setiap Tim Bisa Lima Kali Ganti Pemain|date=30 March suspended.{{Cite news|url=http://juara.bolasport.com/read/sepak-bola/indonesia/181043-timnas.u22.berlaga.aturan.memainkan.pemain.u23.ditangguhkan|title=Timnas U-22 Berlaga, Aturan Memainkan Pemain (association football)|FIFA Laws of the Game]]) were only allowed for U-23 players. == Teams == Eighteen teams competed in the league – all teams from the abandoned [[2015 Indonesia Super League]].
